placements.title: rehearsal is the proof of actual capability
placements.frame: Does this expression treat an operational capability as real only to the extent it has been rehearsed and institutionalized — cadence set, owner named — rather than assumed to exist by default?
placements.why: src-1 mandates a standing monthly rehearsal cadence for Atlas rollback; src-2 supplies the constitutive principle behind it — an unrehearsed rollback is not actually possessed — which the position pass already reads as directive-plus-justification from the same speaker in sequence. This passes the narrative grain test: 'rehearsal proves capability' is a subject future envelopes about other systems/capabilities can keep feeding, not a one-time fact. src-3 and src-4 are the notebook's administrative encoding of that same decision (the cadence field restates src-1's schedule; the owner field names who is accountable for sustaining the rehearsal practice) — both are position-grain facts that evidence this theme's institutionalization rather than themes of their own, so they join this leaf's support rather than minting separately (per the grain-test example: a measurement/fact supports the leaf its theme evidences, it doesn't get its own). No existing strata or narrative leaf exists in this graph yet, so no reuse is possible; the leaf is minted standalone with no under, since nothing in the (empty) strata or structure is even close enough to warrant lineage, and a home hub is not yet legible from a single envelope.
